newsitem.title: FINLAND: OLVI SEES LOWER FULL-YEAR 1996 EARNINGS.
newsitem.headline: OLVI SEES LOWER FULL-YEAR 1996 EARNINGS.

text.p: Finnish drinks company Olvi Oy said in a statement on Tuesday it expects its full-year 1996 pre-tax earnings to be below the 40.9 million markka of 1995.
"Due to weak earnings development in the early part of the year the company's full-year result before reserves and taxes will be lower than last year," Olvi said with its January-August results.
In January-August, Olvi's profit before extraordinary items fell to 20.4 million markka from 32.1 million.
Olvi said it would continue its efforts in beer sales and in the Olvi and Sandels brands and in new packaging, particularly for daily goods retailers.
As a new product, Olvi will in October bring to the market a medium strong beer especially for Christmas.
In January next year, Olvi will introduce half-litre bottles, it said.
Olvi also said it had in September introduced a process-based team structure which aims to improve operational and cost-efficiency, strengthen the market position and enhance quality.
